# Test fixtures

`lund-centre.osm.pbf` is a tiny OpenStreetMap extract of central Lund (the box 55.7040,13.1900 – 55.7060,13.1940, with the ways that cross it kept whole), used by the `moto-regionbuild` tests. It was cut from OSM data of 2026-09-22 with pyosmium.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the [Open Database License (ODbL)](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). The ODbL, not the project's AGPL, applies to this file.
